title: Changing a work order's representative never changes its customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep C.
  • Use a customer whose one Sales Representative is sales rep A.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line and one part, so that its one "Sales Representative" field reads sales rep A (copied from the customer when it was created).
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Change the work order's Sales Representative to sales rep C.
  2. Open the customer's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order reads sales rep C.

Step 2:

  • The customer still shows sales rep A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R32: “Picking a person, or "Unassigned", on a work order or part sale changes only that work order or part sale, never its customer.”
